question: After the current Web UI/session-thread work, should this issue remain the broad tracker for TUI, CLI lifecycle, topic metadata, and import/export, or should those remaining slices be split into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: The remaining behavior spans product UX, protocol shape, persistent state, and multiple clients, so automation should not choose the permanent scope or data model.

options.title: Keep Broad Residual Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella while routing implementation through narrower linked issues or PRs for each accepted slice.

options.title: Split And Close Umbrella
options.body: Create or designate separate canonical issues for CLI, TUI, metadata, and import/export, then close this issue once those links preserve the remaining scope.

options.title: Declare Current Scope Enough
options.body: Treat the current Web UI/sidebar/picker thread management as sufficient and explicitly leave the rest out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Residual Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella while routing implementation through narrower linked issues or PRs for each accepted slice.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged session-thread foundation and recent grouping work, making them the clearest owner for the scope decision.
